race.comment: ASTON SUMMARY (1) is boxed nicely on the inside. Last start finished 6th over 350m at this track beaten 5 lengths (19.86) behind Diplomat in a Grade 5 on November 6. Looks suited and should go close. HAWK MAGIC (3) filled a minor placing last start at this track behind Skeeter Mikado (17.30) in a Grade 5. Can feature again. DEVON DAISIES (2) doesn't have the best strike-rate. Hit the board with a minor placing last time when third (19.87) at this track. Solid record at the distance winning three races. Solid formlines coming through her last run. Expected to feature again. JUSTIFIED JIM (8) cannot be written off despite a miss here at his latest outing.
